subject: GCP Marketplace: approval paths, billing hooks & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Marketplace: approval paths, billing hooks & procurement checklist

Hi team,

Following up from the 1:1 — Acme Cloud (prospect) wants to move to a GCP Marketplace listing and has asked for consolidated procurement instructions and an example flow for how billing and marketplace purchase orders would route. I attached a first-pass checklist (gcp_procurement_checklist.xlsx) — please take a look.

Key asks from Acme:
- Clear procurement path for marketplace SKU vs direct contract
- How billing hooks (billing account mapping, pricing metering) will appear in their console
- Procurement contact list and DD docs we need to provide (SOW, tax forms, SOC2 evidence)

My asks: can each of you call out the gating steps we own and the folks at GCP we should loop in? Vanessa — legal/finance gating and DocuSign path? Jonas — technical listing/artifacts and billing metering hooks? Marissa — customer-facing procurement checklist and the intake template for CSM?

Timeline: Acme is targeting a week-of Aug 24 go/no-go for marketplace procurement intake. I think we should prepare the required artifacts and a one-page mutual action plan by Aug 18.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Head of Sales, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: approval paths, billing hooks & procurement checklist

Thanks — I reviewed the checklist. High level gating from Legal/Finance we need to capture:

1) Commercial approval (discounts, committed usage) — requires Sales + Finance sign-off (estimated 2 business days once deal terms shared).
2) Security/compliance intake — security team to confirm SOC2 scope for marketplace listing (3-5 business days).
3) Procurement & tax — vendor paperwork and W-9/IRS equivalents for international (Acme is US; W-9 + COI).
4) DocuSign & contracting — if marketplace procurement is used we still need a reseller addendum in Contracting for billing reconciliation (Legal to produce a short addendum template).

Action items: Vanessa -> will draft the reseller addendum template and required legal checklist; please share any standard contract language we prefer (Jonas/Dylan). Jonas -> confirm the billing meter and sku mapping doc we will provide to GCP. Marissa -> create a one-page intake for Acme procurement (fields: procurement contact, billing account id, expected start date, PO cadence).

Also recommend we loop in the GCP Marketplace PM and a partner engineering contact to confirm the billing hooks (metering, tiers, usage export). I can email them once we have the intake template.

Vanessa
Director, Business Ops & GTM
Redwood Inference
From: GCP Marketplace PM <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: approval paths, billing hooks & procurement checklist

Hi Vanessa / Dylan / Jonas,

Thanks for the note and checklist. Quick heads-up on the GCP side: for a SaaS billing integration you typically need the following pieces to accelerate procurement and listing approval:

- Marketplace listing artifacts (public product description, pricing plan definitions, terms of service link)
- Billing & metering integration (we support both invoice-based and metered billing; for metered billing we'll need the usage export schema and a sample CSV for test purchases)
- Partner onboarding packet (tax forms, point of contact for billing account linkage, and an authorized signer for the partner account)
- Technical validation window (we can schedule a 2-hour test session to simulate purchase flows and verify metering exports)

I'll attach the partner onboarding checklist and a DocuSign link for the partner enrollment form — please have your legal or finance complete it so we can provision the partner billing hooks. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/agreements/ABC123456789

On timelines: if you can complete onboarding forms and provide the usage export schema by Aug 18 we can aim to enable sandbox metering by Aug 21, which would let Acme run test purchases the following week.

Best,
Alex (GCP Marketplace PM)
GCP Partners
